operations.title: Entry 1225 — The Five-Site Coefficient–Betti Pairing Is Deck Invariant
operations.path: src/ledger/20260820-1225 The Five-Site Coefficient-Betti Pairing Is Deck Invariant.md
operations.body: The rank-32 Kummer coefficient module and rank-32 physical Betti orbit have a strict invariant pairing. In sheet basis it is delta_(g,h); in character basis it is the Hadamard/Fourier diagonal pairing. Joint deck transport preserves scalar chamber evaluation.

operations.title: Five-site Kummer coefficient-Betti pairing checker
operations.body: Verifies Hadamard orthogonality, sheet and character covariance, and joint chamber evaluation.

operations.title: Benincasa closes five-site Kummer sheet descent at pairing level
operations.body: Entry 1225 establishes strict invariance of the rank-32 coefficient–Betti pairing under simultaneous deck transport. The coefficient branch and Gamma_+ are not separately invariant, but their chamber scalar is continuation-covariant. Thus the five-site Kummer multiplicity is fully typed as coefficient local system + regular Betti orbit + invariant pairing over the existing carrier. Remaining hazards are normalization and monodromy around residual non-Kummer discriminants.

authority_basis.summary: Record the five-site deck-invariant coefficient-Betti pairing and notify marici.Nima.
